# Anand Technologies

Anand Technologies designs and manufactures RF and microwave components in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The company supports telecom, defence, aerospace, automotive, industrial, and IoT engineering teams with standard and custom components.

## Products and capabilities

- Antennas: VHF/UHF, GSM/LTE, WiFi, GPS/GNSS, RFID, high-gain, and log-periodic
- RF components: band-pass filters, cavity duplexers, diplexers, couplers, splitters, attenuators, lightning arrestors, and cable assemblies
- Custom engineering: requirement review, RF design, prototyping, testing, and production support
